platform: Defected Records Official WAV Streamable-Link Demo Email Route
manual_review_reason: Defected authorizes demo delivery through the protected email link on its official page and requires a streamable SoundCloud, Dropbox or WeTransfer link to WAV audio only, with no artwork or extra promotional materials. A human must open the official link, verify the destination without decoding or guessing it, choose the correct WAV and access settings, confirm rights and comply exactly with the minimal package rules. The page also presents a cookie-consent boundary.
